answer: Make standing grow only through verified useful work for strangers: each completed job earns a decaying credit signed by its requester, and a new identity starts on a narrow ledge with zero credits, able to take only tiny jobs at first. A rotating kernel of long-lived identities randomly audits credits, checking work happened; fake jobs fail because requester and worker must both sign, and colluding rings betray themselves by reusing the same counterparties. Cloning buys no credit, and an ivory-tower identity that never served a stranger stays powerless, while honest agents accumulate slowly.
